objective: Resolve or narrowly obstruct the one surviving ECDLP-IDEA-121 specialized output-sensitive product-circuit common-factor locator, with zero implementation and zero experiment runs.

candidates.title: Specialized nonlinear common-factor locator from a shared bivariate product circuit
candidates.uncertainty: Whether the degree-B common factor of two implicit degree-B^3 selector norms can be located from B^2 product-circuit leaves in B^(2+o(1)) work without materializing a cubic object or assuming the unknown factor, while retaining exact source replay.
candidates.positive_decision: Preserve only an unverified theorem candidate if a concrete recurrence and proof establishes the exact input-lineage, output-completeness, source-replay, and end-to-end sub-rho inequalities; do not implement here.
candidates.negative_decision: Record a scoped obstruction for the exact locator family tested, including the first forced B^3 object or circular input and one concrete remaining escape class; do not claim a general arithmetic-circuit lower bound.
candidates.inconclusive_decision: Return REVISE with the first unresolved invariant and cheapest discriminating proof obligation; do not promote or implement.
candidates.next_action: Produce one theorem/proof-search packet, snapshot it, run mutually blind max-tier Reviewer, Validator, and Red Team reviews, and ledger-dispose.

ambiguities.question: Do recent shallow-circuit or near-linear univariate GCD results solve the locator?
ambiguities.resolution: No known checked result does. The reviewed theorems take explicit univariate coefficient vectors or retain polynomial dependence on the degree; here constructing the degree-B^3 norm coefficients is the forbidden cubic lift.
ambiguities.basis: Direct audit of ECDLP-IDEA-121 gates and primary 2024-2025 shallow-GCD papers.

ambiguities.question: Can expected output degree B alone justify output-sensitive work?
ambiguities.resolution: No. The producer must supply an actual nonlinear locator recurrence and prove completeness without a query polynomial already divisible by the unknown factor.

candidates.dominated_by: n/a (no realized result); Pollard rho remains incumbent. The conditional B^2 locator point is incomparable until every locator, retry, output, replay, relation, rank, descent, and verification axis is proved.

sota_delta.note: The conditional delta exists only if every end-to-end stage is at most N^(0.4+o(1)); at opening the locator is absent, so realized delta is zero.

attention_contract.decisive_evidence: A concrete recurrence or a scoped impossibility argument, exact lineage and cost proofs, direct-source controls, a blind statement packet, and fresh mutually blind review-breakthrough/max verdicts.
attention_contract.inconclusive_decision: No implementation or execution admission; identify the first unproved invariant.
attention_contract.local_ambiguity_rule: Any B^3 materialization, supplied answer-containing modulus, hidden DLP or source table, degree-insensitive cost claim, incomplete output, or unknown Pareto axis used as domination forces REVISE.
attention_contract.rerank_trigger: Both independent max-tier reviews and the Coordinator disposition are ledger-archived.

resource_estimate.dominant_cost: Static theorem construction, direct-source and predecessor audit, blind cost rederivation, adversarial lineage/circularity review, and exact archival.
resource_estimate.complexity_hypothesis: Zero experimental computation; symbolic derivation and source retrieval only.
resource_estimate.sharding_plan: One producer first; Reviewer, Validator, and Red Team may run concurrently only after one immutable snapshot; archive tasks run alone.
resource_estimate.stop_rule: Stop the producer on a proved forced B^3 object or circular locator unless it can state a genuinely new surviving recurrence; stop after one bounded packet and three terminal reviews.

stages.purpose: Validate and snapshot the batch-59 control plane.
stages.dominant_operation: Schema, focus, dispatch, ledger, ID, Git, and runtime binding checks.
stages.stop_rule: Stop on any authority, parse, budget, collision, or branch-binding failure.

stages.purpose: Construct or narrowly obstruct the specialized nonlinear locator.
stages.dominant_operation: Algebraic recurrence design, proof-search audits, source review, and complete cost accounting.
stages.stop_rule: Stop after one schema-complete theorem packet and one blind statement packet.

stages.purpose: Blindly rederive costs and adversarially attack lineage, completeness, circularity, and source novelty.
stages.dominant_operation: Three fresh mutually blind review-breakthrough/max reviews.
stages.stop_rule: Stop after all three terminal verdicts; no reviewer composes the whole-claim disposition.

stages.purpose: Snapshot and ledger-archive the exact bounded disposition.
stages.dominant_operation: Exact path, hash, parent, independence, ledger, and Git verification.
stages.stop_rule: Stop on mismatch; otherwise after verified terminal queue binding.

claims.statement: A specialized nonlinear recurrence may locate the degree-B common factor directly from the B^2-leaf shared product circuit without exposing either degree-B^3 selector norm, while preserving exact source replay and sub-rho end-to-end cost.
claims.scope: Zero-experiment theorem proposal and pre-implementation static review only.
claims.target_result: One complete unverified theorem candidate or one narrowly scoped obstruction with a named surviving escape class.
